Use case: precise-object-edit. IMAGE1 is edit target C19 three-pose atlas. IMAGE2 is only a HAIR LENGTH reference for another private first class. Keep IMAGE1 character's narrow sleepy eyes, quiet personality, slim face, all expressions/poses/uniform/flag/two chest bars/table/pixel style exactly.
Change ONLY HAIR in ALL THREE panels: remove ALL long bangs. Give him a SHORT MILITARY CREW CUT, approximately1cm on top and very close cropped sides; ears fully uncovered, entire forehead exposed from high hairline to eyebrows. Hair shorter than corporal and sergeant. No fringe hanging over forehead, no bowl cut, no hair toward eyebrows. Match shortness of image2, but do not copy its face or expressions. Keep C19 recognizable. Preserve true alpha,1536x1024,3equal512pxcells, no text.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this three-pose atlas, preserving faces, sleepy cheeky expressions, pose/hands/body/table/flag/pixel style and transparency. Make TWO focused corrections in ALL THREE poses:
1. HAIR: this is the highest enlisted SERGEANT, so top hair must be clearly LONGER than other soldiers but still a tidy military haircut. Change current buzzcut to a thick short military crew cut with 3cm top, raised squared silhouette, very short tapered sides, ears and full forehead exposed. No bangs on eyebrows, no shaggy hair. Top should have noticeably more volume than the corporal reference (existing top about2cm). Preserve unique face, no hat.
2. LEFT CHEST POCKET (viewer right): current badge wrongly has THREE bars. ERASE THE WHOLE OLD RANK PATCH INTERIOR. Redraw a taller olive rectangle centered on pocket BODY below flap, containing EXACTLY FOUR separate BLACK HORIZONTAL STRIPES and THREE olive gaps. Count top-to-bottom: black1,olivegap,black2,olivegap,black3,olivegap,black4. Four bars like four short stacked minus signs. Extend patch downward slightly to fit, all four fully visible in each pose.
Green command cloth should wrap around long narrow camo shoulder straps that run from neck to shoulder end, horizontal along shoulder slope; no shoulder rank because enlisted. Preserve anatomical right sleeve Taegeukgi flag. Output1536x1024 transparent, same3equal512cells. No other changes.

Use case: precise-object-edit. IMAGE 1 is the edit target, a 3-pose Korean military pixel sprite atlas. IMAGE 2 is a SUPPORTING reference ONLY for the correctly shaped long shoulder epaulette strap; do not copy its face, cap rank or diamond rank. Preserve target's face, expressions, personality, hands, body, hair, table and all poses.
CRITICAL: erase every upright collar rank badge and rank mark on front chest. Build a LONG NARROW HORIZONTAL CLOTH STRAP on TOP of EACH trapezius, from neck/collar INNER HIGH end to shoulder seam OUTER LOW end, about 20 degrees below horizontal. 85px long and 24px wide, stitched camo border and a small fastening button at inner neck end. Rank slides onto this fabric sleeve/frame. The insignia must LIE SIDEWAYS, rotated to align its main vertical axis with LENGTH of strap, along slope of shoulder. Like image2, flat on shoulder, never an upright rectangle on front torso/collar. Each pose must have matching rank count on both straps (natural hand occlusion permitted).
Staff sergeant. ONE black downward-V chevron rotated sideways along each strap (apex toward outer shoulder end). NO green command band. Preserve hat's ONE gold downward V (apex down) exactly.
Keep Taegeukgi white flag on anatomical RIGHT lateral upper sleeve (viewer LEFT), not chest. Preserve all remaining insignia. True transparent 1536x1024 PNG, 3 equal 512px wide cells. Do not add shadows or glows beyond existing sprite. Keep whole sprites inside cells. Chunky pixel art exactly, no text/watermarks.
